sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM happy path: verified push writes lineage first, then binds the RITM
sys_atf_test.description: A well-formed SAM push validates, pull-verifies (canned in test_mode), writes lineage before any RITM exists (fail-closed ordering), then binds the lineage row to the created RITM — the exact sequence scripted-rest/sam_inbound_ritm.js follows for a 201.

sys_atf_step.description: Assert the preconditions this test depends on: test_mode is on and the instance is declared non-prod. Fail fast rather than silently exercising a real tenant.
Contract validation (clause 2 of the endpoint): a push carrying every required field must validate.
Pull-verify (clause 3): in test_mode, fetchIdentityRequest returns a canned approved IdentityRequest — the check the endpoint runs before trusting anything the caller asserted.

LINEAGE FIRST, then bind the RITM (clauses 6-8, in one step so the lineage sys_id never has to cross a step boundary): write the lineage record before any RITM exists, create the RITM the same way the endpoint does (a plain sc_request insert), then bind the lineage row to it — this is the write-back ServiceNow performs so the SDIM has a RITM number to record on IdentityRequest.externalTicketId.
Assert the lineage row now carries the RITM number end to end — this is the value the SDIM reads back and stamps onto IdentityRequest.externalTicketId.
sys_atf_step.inputs: table = x_fed_day2_ops_integration conditions = record_type=sam_lineage^sam_request_id=ATF-SAM-0001 assert = ritm == {ritm_number captured in step 400} AND entra_object_id == atf-correlation-0001
